newsitem.title: CHILE: Banco Sud Americano places bonds.
newsitem.headline: Banco Sud Americano places bonds.

text.p: Banco Sud Americano completed its placement of $100 million in 10-year subordinated bonds on the international market Wednesday, General Manager Juan Luis Kostner said.
"This placement strengthens the bank's patrimonial base and facilitates the development of new business," he told a news conference.
The bond placement was via Citicorp Securities Inc and co- led by Salomon Brothers and Scotia Capital Markets (USA), said Kostner.
This week, Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co assigned a Triple- B plus to Sud Americano's senior unsecured foreign currency debt, and Triple-B to its long-term subordinated foreign currency debt.
With assets of $3.7 billion at end-1996, Sud Americano is Chile's sixth largest private bank.
